mapper.select: select * from registration where patient_id=#{patientId} order by id desc
select * from registration where doctor_id=#{doctorId} order by work_date desc,id desc
select * from registration where doctor_id=#{doctorId} and status='已支付' order by work_date,time_slot,id
mapper.update: update registration set status='已支付',pay_type=#{payType},pay_time=now() where id=#{id} and status='待支付'
update registration set status='已取消' where id=#{id} and status in ('待支付','已支付')
update registration set status='已完成',finish_time=now() where id=#{id} and status='已支付'
mapper.select: select count(*) from registration r join schedule s on r.doctor_id=s.doctor_id and r.work_date=s.work_date and r.time_slot=s.time_slot where r.visitor_id=#{visitorId} and s.id=#{scheduleId} and r.status in ('待支付','已支付')
select count(*) from registration where doctor_id=#{doctorId} and status in ('待支付','已支付')
